findings.excerpt: In the Trophy race, John Patterson stayed on top, though the gap at the summit tightened from 10 shots to 3.
By the 5th he had 16 Stableford points banked, built on a birdie at the par-5 2nd, with a single blemish at the brutal SI-1 4th.
Three holes, no net pars, eight gross shots gone, on a stretch that included the SI-2 12th.
What had promised something special finished as 34 points and +22 gross.

findings.excerpt: John Patterson arrived at Royal Óbidos with a ten-shot lead in the TEG 9 Trophy, built on a near-record 49-point round two.
He bled 8 shots across holes 2 to 4: a double bogey at the par-5 2nd, then triple bogeys at the 3rd and the 4th, the last of those on the hardest hole on the course.
The total came to 34 points, a fall of 15 from his round two score.
He remained top of the Trophy standings, which is the only mercy available here.

findings.excerpt: The lead that had looked unassailable now stood at three shots going into round four.
David Mullin, meanwhile, continued to lead the Green Jacket race, his advantage entirely untroubled by Patterson's afternoon.
